items.item: A stepper names each step and lets the user go back to earlier steps
items.evidence: renderStepper(): STEPS = Tải lên, Ghép cột, Xem trước, Nhập; completed earlier steps render as <button data-act="goto"> (only while no job running and not finished); also a Quay lại button in the bar.

items.item: Column mapping auto-matches headers and marks required target fields
items.evidence: reparse() auto-maps headers via headerKey() against FIELDS[].alias (Vietnamese diacritic folding); viewMapping() says 'Hệ thống đã tự ghép N trên M cột', required fields show asterisks in selects ('SKU *') and a 'Trường bắt buộc' panel; goNext() blocks if required fields are missing.

items.item: The preview table shows per-row errors and an error count, and offers to download the failing rows
items.evidence: viewReview(): summary line '… có lỗi' count, <details> '${c.errors} dòng có lỗi' with per-row messages, Kết quả/Chi tiết columns with red badge and message per row, filter 'Chỉ dòng lỗi (n)', button data-act="download-failed" 'Tải các dòng lỗi (n)'.

items.item: The import shows progress, can continue in the background, and ends with a summary of created, updated and failed rows
items.evidence: viewRun(): role=progressbar with 'Đang nhập x trên y' and %; button data-act="bg-import" 'Chạy nền' with renderBanner() progress banner and toast on completion; viewSummary() shows Đã tạo / Đã cập nhật / Bỏ qua / Lỗi figures plus failed-row table and download.

items.item: The flow runs on a page or a full-width panel, not inside a small modal
items.evidence: Whole wizard renders into <main id="main"> with breadcrumb and h1 'Nhập sản phẩm từ file CSV'; the only modal is confirmDialog for confirmations (screenshot shows full page).

items.item: A template file is offered for download before upload
items.evidence: Step 1 card 'Chưa có file?' with button data-act="download-template" 'Tải file mẫu (CSV UTF-8 có BOM)' next to the dropzone (visible in first viewport), saves mau-nhap-san-pham.csv.

notes: Audit score 100, no violations. Clean, dense, restrained slate/blue UI with one icon set, 4-6px radii, no gradients, glass, emoji, KPI tiles or promo cards. The summary step has four small bordered number boxes (Đã tạo, Đã cập nhật, Bỏ qua, Lỗi), but they are a result summary with no icons or deltas, so not flagged as kpi-icon-tiles. Header avatar 'LH' is a real person's initials. Sidebar is light slate, not navy. Minor: the sticky bottom bar overlaps the lower columns table in the first viewport; the 'Tiếp theo' bar button is present while no file is chosen (it shows a validation error on click).
